reason: A better addresses genuinely dynamic loading by extending to 10²–10³ s⁻¹ with a split-Hopkinson-bar experiment, while directly testing whether twin density tracks enhanced flow stress and strain hardening across temperature; B’s maximum rate of 1 s⁻¹ is insufficient to establish high-rate dynamic behavior. Both propose the same physically plausible but unverified twinning–dislocation competition, though A should specify one loading mode and use strain-matched interrupted tests to separate mechanism from accumulated strain.
